notes: Audio checks that a track fits the channel identity (ADR-0044): per genre, the tempo band and the loudness-rise warning. The C4 event's first genre tag selects the profile; a genre without a profile is not checked here.

Tempo is measured with P6's onset-autocorrelation estimator (media_factory.audio.features) over 50-200 BPM with the tempo prior centred on the band. A tempo half or double the band counts as inside it (half-time feel, for example 140 BPM chillstep felt at 70), so the check catches the dance range between the band and its double, not high-BPM drum and bass. tolerance_bpm absorbs the estimator's error at the band edges (a 140 BPM click track measures 69.98). Below min_confidence, or with no beat (ambient), the tempo is unknown and nothing is judged.

Calibration 2026-11-01 on 39 real tracks in output_media (Suno, Lyria, Stable Audio; lo-fi and chill): every measured tempo was 72-89 BPM or had no beat, so none would be held. The 3 s RMS level rose by up to 17.3 dB inside 4 s in calm tracks (breakdown returns), so a rise cannot separate an EDM drop from a breakdown: it is a non-blocking warning above loudness_rise_warn_db, recorded for later calibration.

focus_electronic.source: ADR-0044 decision 2 (70-110 BPM on every track; no EDM drops).
